title: Unsafe .NET call doc.LoadXml (csharp) — review required
description: The csharp call doc.LoadXml deserializes, parses XML, or writes raw HTML. Hostile input becomes gadgets or script. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms trust or replaces it with XmlReader with secure settings.
remediation: Replace with XmlReader with secure settings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any doc.LoadXml call matches.
